# Lakeside Water Tariff (2026)

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software evaluation; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Charges

The monthly base charge is 13.50 euros. Water usage costs 2.05 euros per cubic metre.

## 2 Billing

Bills are issued every month.

## 3 Changes in 2026

The 2026 tariff raised the monthly base charge from 12.00 euros to 13.50 euros and moved billing from every two months to every month.
